meta.description: Gate set for gated teacher promotion: 23 ten-turn editing sessions on Z-Image-Turbo-generated 1024x1024 source images (images/<id>.png). Source images and sessions are disjoint from LME-Bench (only the standardized global-edit phrasings are shared); used only to select teacher checkpoints during training.
